unsupported: Mike's Welding operates from a storefront and workshop in Sterling, Alaska, with a mailing address at PO Box 627.
The shop serves the local community and seasonal visitors along the Kenai Peninsula.
The shop specializes in welding and metal fabrication, with a notable seasonal focus on dip net sales and repairs for the Kenai River personal use fishery.
Primary customers include participants in the Kenai River dip net fishery—both Alaska residents and non-residents—who purchase new nets or bring existing gear for repair and custom modification.
The shop also addresses general welding and fabrication needs for residents and businesses in the Sterling area.
The company differentiates itself by aligning its schedule with the time-sensitive dip net season, ensuring availability when demand peaks.
This seasonal responsiveness, combined with on-site fabrication capability, allows Mike's Welding to serve both immediate repair needs and custom orders for the fishery.
Known for: Extended Friday and Saturday hours during Kenai River dip net season (July 10–31); On-site dip net sales, repair, and custom fabrication; Local welding and metal fabrication services
